mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_event (id, ts, workspace_id, actor_type, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, outcome, reason, trace_id, span_id, service, request_id, subject, client_ip, details_json, forwarded) VALUES (#{id}, #{ts}, #{workspaceId}, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{outcome}, #{reason}, #{traceId}, #{spanId}, #{service}, #{requestId}, #{subject}, #{clientIp}, #{detailsJson}, FALSE)
mapper.select: SELECT id, ts, workspace_id AS workspaceId, actor_type AS actorType, actor_id AS actorId, action, resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId, outcome, reason, trace_id AS traceId, span_id AS spanId, service, request_id AS requestId, client_ip AS clientIp, details_json AS detailsJson, forwarded FROM audit_event WHERE (#{workspaceId}::varchar IS NULL OR workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) AND (#{actorId}::varchar IS NULL OR actor_id = #{actorId}) AND (#{action}::varchar IS NULL OR action = #{action}) AND (#{resourceType}::varchar IS NULL OR resource_type = #{resourceType}) AND (#{resourceId}::varchar IS NULL OR resource_id = #{resourceId}) AND (#{outcome}::varchar IS NULL OR outcome = #{outcome}) AND (#{from}::timestamptz IS NULL OR ts >= #{from}) AND (#{to}::timestamptz IS NULL OR ts <= #{to}) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, ts, workspace_id AS workspaceId, actor_type AS actorType, actor_id AS actorId, action, resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId, outcome, reason, trace_id AS traceId, span_id AS spanId, service, request_id AS requestId, client_ip AS clientIp, details_json AS detailsJson, forwarded FROM audit_event WHERE forwarded = FALSE ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_event SET forwarded = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM audit_event WHERE forwarded = TRUE AND ts < #{before}
mapper.select: SELECT id, ts, workspace_id AS workspaceId, actor_type AS actorType, actor_id AS actorId, action, resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId, outcome, reason, trace_id AS traceId, span_id AS spanId, service, request_id AS requestId, subject, client_ip AS clientIp, details_json AS detailsJson FROM audit_event WHERE hash IS NULL ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_event SET prev_hash = #{prevHash}, hash = #{hash} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_seal (workspace_key, last_id, last_hash, events_sealed, sealed_at) VALUES (#{workspaceKey}, #{lastId}, #{lastHash}, #{count}, now()) ON CONFLICT (workspace_key) DO UPDATE SET last_id = EXCLUDED.last_id, last_hash = EXCLUDED.last_hash, events_sealed = audit_seal.events_sealed + EXCLUDED.events_sealed, sealed_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT id, ts, workspace_id AS workspaceId, actor_type AS actorType, actor_id AS actorId, action, resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId, outcome, reason, trace_id AS traceId, span_id AS spanId, service, request_id AS requestId, subject, client_ip AS clientIp, details_json AS detailsJson, prev_hash AS prevHash, hash FROM audit_event WHERE (CASE WHEN #{workspaceKey} = '_system' THEN workspace_id IS NULL ELSE workspace_id = #{workspaceKey} END) AND hash IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT workspace_key AS workspaceKey, last_id AS lastId, last_hash AS lastHash, events_sealed AS eventsSealed, sealed_at AS sealedAt FROM audit_seal WHERE workspace_key = #{workspaceKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_forward_progress (channel, last_forwarded_id, batches, last_forwarded_at) VALUES (#{channel}, #{lastForwardedId}, #{batchSize}, now()) ON CONFLICT (channel) DO UPDATE SET last_forwarded_id = EXCLUDED.last_forwarded_id, batches = audit_forward_progress.batches + EXCLUDED.batches, last_forwarded_at = now()
